text:
SRE Bot: INCIDENT CREATED — P1: KV cache growth + streaming token-cadence stalls observed in prod us-west-2. Alerts: high eviction rate on kv-cache + streaming partial-flush exceptions.

Alyssa (oncall): I'm on it. Seeing a spike in 5xx for /v1/stream endpoints and multiple customer reports of streams that stop mid-token.

Matt (eng-runtime): I can repro on canary. After the 14:08 deploy batcher config was changed: batch_max_tokens 2048 -> 4096 and prefetch=true. KV cache size growth ~3x on inference-03.

Priya (eng-ml): Quick hypothesis — continuous batching increase + prefetching causes more aggressive KV key churn and paging. The streamer has a race where partial_flush() assumes KV entries exist; evictions can make kv_get() return null mid-stream => stalls.

Kai (support): Customer impact: 4 PLG tenants reported ~40% failed streams in last 20m. No PII/data leak reported. Support ticket: https://support.redwood.ai/t/1234 — customers requesting ETA.

Alyssa (oncall): Immediate mitigations: rollback the batch_max_tokens change in canary, disable prefetch on affected fleets, and attempt a small defensive hotfix to the streamer. Rolling the rollback now.

Deploy Bot: @Alyssa started deploy: rolling update config/continuous-batcher -> ci/continuous-batcher:rollback-20260315. 2/6 pods updated.

Matt (eng-runtime): Also applying a temporary config cap to KV cache: lowering per-pod prefix cache from unlimited -> 8GB and bump eviction threshold to avoid paging cascade. Patch snippet: ```yaml
batcher:
  max_tokens: 2048
  prefetch: false
kv_cache:
  max_memory_mb: 8192
  eviction_policy: lru
```

Priya (eng-ml): I'll prepare a small runtime guard: if kv_get() returns null in partial_flush, schedule an async retry and skip the blocking path. Minimal change, unit tests passing locally.

Jordan (product): Coordinating comms — drafting status page: "Degraded streaming for subset of customers; mitigation in progress." Will publish after we have rollback metrics. :eyes:

Alyssa (oncall): Rollback metrics coming in — error rate dropped ~65% and streaming stalls reduced but we still see partial_flush exceptions on two pods (inference-03, inference-07).

Matt (eng-runtime): Looking at stack traces: streamer::partial_flush() -> kv_get() -> null deref. Patch will add defensive null check + schedule retry with backoff. Also add tracing id to the flush path for correlation.

Priya (eng-ml): Hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/streaming/pull/789 - includes defensive check + integration test that simulates eviction mid-stream. CI green. Can we push as patch release?

Alyssa (oncall): Approved. @Matt please coordinate container build and deploy.

Deploy Bot: build started for streaming/runner:v2.1.3-hotfix (triggered by @Matt).

Deploy Bot: build success. rolling deploy streaming/runner:v2.1.3-hotfix — 1/4 pods updated and healthy.

Kai (support): Customer-facing ETA updated to ~20-30 minutes. Notifying affected customers. Dedicated customers unaffected so far.

Matt (eng-runtime): Enabling debug-level logs for partial-flush on the two suspect pods and attaching tracing. Also temporarily increase disk buffer for kv-cache on inference-03 in case paging recurs.

Alyssa (oncall): Current status: mitigations applied (rollback + prefetch disabled + hotfix deployed). Impact reduced to ~10% failed streams across the cluster. Handing off to @Matt for monitoring and night coverage. Summary for handoff:
- Root cause: continuous-batching config increase + prefetch led to KV cache blowup/paging.
- Failure mode: paging triggered evictions during streaming; streamer partial_flush didn't handle null KV handles -> token cadence stalls/partial output.
- Actions taken: rolled back batch_max_tokens, disabled prefetch, applied KV cache caps, deployed streamer hotfix to guard against null KV, enabled extra tracing.
- Customer impact: Some PLG tenants affected; support notified; no data leak.
- Next actions: monitor metrics and traces for 2h, run replay of affected traces, collect logs for postmortem.

Matt (eng-runtime): Ack. I'll keep watch and escalate if anything regresses. Will also schedule a postmortem tomorrow and include replayed traces + config diff.

Jordan (product): I'll draft the customer-facing postmortem and coordinate with CS for follow-ups.

Alyssa (oncall): Thanks team :thumbsup: If any regression, tag SRE Bot with `incident escalate`. Switching channel to monitoring mode.

SRE Bot: incident status -> monitoring. Escalation window: 2h. Assigned to Matt (oncall).

(Reaction notes: many :thumbsup: and :heart: reactions on the final messages)
